subject.title: feat(android): add Wear OS app MVP

question: Should OpenClaw accept and maintain a first-party Wear OS companion app in core now, or should this work be split or moved out of the release path?
rationale: The patch is a large new first-party app surface with direct gateway auth, phone-proxy behavior, notification/UI entry points, and release/CI obligations; code review can identify blockers, but only maintainers can accept the ongoing product and security ownership.

options.title: Sponsor after blockers
options.body: Keep this PR open, require the concrete security/CI/license/auth fixes plus stronger real-device or emulator logs, then route it through Android and security owners before merge.

options.title: Split infrastructure first
options.body: Extract only the shared gateway/proxy pieces that Android owners want now, and leave the Wear UI/app module for a later smaller sponsored PR.

options.title: Move outside core
options.body: Close or redirect the Wear companion as an external app/plugin-style companion if maintainers do not want to own a first-party Wear release surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after blockers
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open, require the concrete security/CI/license/auth fixes plus stronger real-device or emulator logs, then route it through Android and security owners before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is currently assigned to obviyus and the Android history points to Ayaan Zaidi/obviyus as the strongest current routing owner.
